Introduction
This document details the testing steps P1, which are performed
on the DFR type 16132, manufacturer Hathaway, on an annually basis Y1 .
Safety Precautions
Work order should be issued,
The fault recorder should be in service
Appropriate personnel protective equipment must be used.
Tools and Equipment
Normal or digital multimeter,
Complete set of screwdrivers.
Blower and musk.
Work to be Carried Out
Clean the outside and inside panel of DFR from dust using
 the blower
Check all parts wiring of DFR system. "not loose"
Check the 4 fuses in the power unit.
Check 32 current shunt.
TB (10) the I / P terminal
 blocks
 Ground Bus.
 Alarm inter face relay (K 1- K 4) fail operation fault
 service)
 G1 + G2 (Alarm relay panel)
 The terminals of to a relay and digital channels to the data
 acquisition unit (and the of syn-IRIG printer Ex. Start etc ).
Check the local printer and its functions test.
Check the sensors and transformer of over a
 reset relay and
 earth fault relay setting valves (1+2+3(0.8) and 4 90.1)
Check the program of the data acquisition unit and the
 default valve (Altering DAV par ameters ).
Test and review the calibration to analog
 charnels on R1to
 R32 to the tow DAV (from analog and patch Board card ).
Check the A/D (Analog to digital converter) and the fall
 scrle deflection (4.27) (gim adjustment).
Check the test function.
At last put the system on auto mode and show the lamps
 indication.
Doing one rigger and show the result and the rmelo form of
 the o/p sheit.
